scope: Mapped City Bridges edges overlapping paved road and within80m of mapped water. Includes ground-supported culvert and stacked-road cases requiring classification. Not a certified complete bridge inventory.
exclusions: Ordinary road gradients without mapped bridge and water adjacency are outside this bounded screen.
No invented bridge at pond edges or trail crossings.
Not all >1m DSM-DTM differences are road errors; canopy, vehicles, medians and overlapping roads may explain some.

inventory.sourceRelation: Mapped bridge-edge/paved-road overlap near water; actual road/water polygons do not overlap.
inventory.screenPriority: Higher: coherent >3m separation supported by >=10 coarse samples
inventory.repairDecision: Pending correction agent native-pavement and crossing-order classification; this inventory does not authorize raising every road.
classificationLimits: Closest street can be the lower route at stacked crossings.
Nearby Shoreline can be a pond beside an interchange, not water directly under this road.
